requests.name: hippo
requests.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: photoreal miniature animal icon for museum wall collection. Input1 is the existing animal for material and identity; input2 sphinx is CAMERA, ORIENTATION and lighting reference only, not animal material. Re-render animal in a LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE like that sphinx: head at left, tail at right, entire animal's long side facing viewer parallel to image plane. Camera only slightly above so a narrow amount of back/top is visible. Nearly orthographic long lens, no isometric, no three-quarter frontal head, no foreshortening. Natural standing pose, four legs with near/far feet subtly staggered and anatomically credible, all feet visible enough to read. Strong soft upper-left/front light, shaded lower-right relief, restrained violet bounce to sit on purple chart. Detailed lifelike skin and strong readable contrast. One centered animal on square REAL transparent PNG, longest solid extent about92-94%, clear margins. No ground, shelf, wall, plinth, scenery, text or cast shadow; only natural self-shading. Keep realistic animal coloration, not stone. Subject: adult hippopotamus with heavy barrel-shaped torso, broad low head held in true LEFT profile, mouth closed, small ears, short thick legs, tiny tail. Gray-brown slightly pink skin folds and pores, restrained satin sheen; no wet floor. Keep it calm and realistic, not a cartoon.
